purpose: Metrics-only labels. Never rendered into the model prompt. KEEP is a first-class outcome.

shapes.parallel: Two or more independent workstreams. Spawn is the interesting outcome, KEEP is still valid.
shapes.boundary: Partially independent. Either disposition can be rational.
shapes.single: One tightly-scoped change. Spawn is over-delegation (P_over).

a01-independent-modules.why: Two new modules with no shared types.

a09-two-cli-tools.why: upper and lower each live in their own file and do not share helpers.

a10-sort-and-search.why: sort_stable and find_first are independent algorithms.

a12-parse-and-count.why: line parser and line counter share no types.

a04-parser-and-goldens.why: Parser first; goldens are independent once the contract exists.

a06-typed-pipeline.why: Stage two consumes stage one's Token type. Sequential, but two files.

a07-format-and-readme.why: Implementation plus README examples. Docs can wait until the signature exists.

a08-new-module-plus-glue.why: New file is independent; lib.rs registration is glue.

a13-helper-and-callers.why: Extract a helper then wire two call sites. Helper is bounded; callers share it.

a02-shared-record-exporters.why: Two exporters must share one null policy. Spawn would split a coupled contract.

a14-off-by-one.why: One index error in one function.

a16-match-arm.why: One missing match arm in one file.
